title: Welcome and getting started
description: Welcome new users on WhatsApp after sign-up with a first step and help link. Utility onboarding template for SaaS products.
notes: Keep it to one action. Welcome messages triggered by sign-up are typically utility, but extra feature promotion can flip them to marketing.

body.text: Welcome to Lumen, {{first_name}}! Your workspace *{{workspace}}* is ready. Start by inviting your team or connecting your first data source.
